address: ABC Brickworks Market & Food Centre, #01-112, Blk 6 Jalan Bukit Merah, 150006, Singapore
bio: Besides Penangese quick bites from char kway teow to prawn mee, this stall is famous for Penang assam laksa – the tangy, mildly hot yellowtail fish broth works magic with the noodles; but it's the fresh mint that makes it so distinctive....
